TEXT.English: Peter's Admiralty turned the harbor into a state arm for Baltic trade, naval administration, foreign technical import, and a western-facing court centered on St. Petersburg.
Petrine Russia unique Harbor replacement. Keeps the Harbor's trade and seafood health benefits while adding 1 Trade Route, 25% Research, and 1 Culture.
The Collegium of Foreign Affairs reflects Peter's shift from old chancery habits toward a westernized bureaucracy that handled diplomacy, translation, intelligence, and elite state service.
Petrine Russia unique Courthouse replacement. Keeps the normal maintenance reduction while adding 25% Research, 4 Espionage, 1 Culture, and 2 Spy slots.

Peter I forced Russia toward a westernized court, a more disciplined service bureaucracy, and a Baltic-facing state built around foreign expertise, diplomacy, and maritime access. His rule tied elite culture to state modernization rather than leaving it as courtly ornament alone.
